preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^6.
All characters in the string S are alphanumeric.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of characters to be added is non-negative.
The minimum number of characters to be added is less than or equal to the length of the string S.

postconditions.expression: all(S[:output] == S[len(S)-output:][::-1] for output in range(output+1))
postconditions.description: The string S with the first output characters added to the front is a palindrome.
